name: strategy_factory_judge
status: pre-registered (v1, then one amendment from the owner's second brief); no candidate has been scored and no feature matrix has been read by any search or judge; the commit time is the authority

owner_bars.oos_ev: mean net USD per trade out of sample > 0 with the lower confidence bound > 0
owner_bars.max_drawdown: < 20% of capital, capital fixed at 164 USD (the live epoch's base); drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough fall of the cumulative out-of-sample PnL path in trade order
owner_bars.stress: still EV > 0 when latency is doubled (10 s) and every taker leg pays 1 cent worse

additions_to_the_bars.why: at 10,000 candidates an hour a per-candidate 95% bound passes about 250 by luck every hour, so the owner's bars are necessary but not enough
additions_to_the_bars.corrected_lower_bound: mean - z * se, where se is the window-clustered standard error of the per-trade PnL (trades summed to windows) and z = the standard normal quantile of 1 - 0.05 / N, N = the number of distinct candidates scored on the same out-of-sample blocks (a Bonferroni correction); a candidate is promoted only if this corrected bound is > 0 as well as the owner's uncorrected bound (z = 1.645 at 95% one-sided)
additions_to_the_bars.no_promotion_by_the_judge_alone: a pass puts a candidate on the promotion ladder as 'passed judge'; paper trading on Session 1's engine is the forward confirmation and arming is the owner's decision

walk_forward.unit: block of consecutive window closes spanning 6 hours while the data is under 10 days; 1 day once 10 days exist (the rule is scale-free)
walk_forward.epoch: epoch e trains on every block before its test blocks and is judged on its test blocks; candidates are frozen at selection and scored on blocks after their selection only, never refit
walk_forward.evolution_leak_guard: parents, fitness and tuning for a candidate created at epoch e use only data before epoch e's test blocks; the out-of-sample result of epoch e may inform candidates created at epochs after e, never e itself
walk_forward.reported: per candidate: train metrics, out-of-sample metrics, stress metrics, both bounds, status and the reason for every failure

execution_model.orders: taker IOC at the seen touch: entry at the ask of the side held (YES ask, or 1 - YES bid for NO) of the book row at decision time + latency; filled quantity = min(stake quantity, displayed touch size where known); where the touch size is not recorded the lane's median L2-era touch size is used
execution_model.fee: the exact venue formula, ceil(0.07 * contracts * P * (1 - P)) to the cent per order, as sim_core.taker_fee
execution_model.exits: hold to settlement ($0 fee), or any of: take-profit and stop on the side's taker exit price, confirmed one grid step later, time barrier; every exit order arrives latency seconds after the decision and pays the taker fee
execution_model.one_position: at most one open position per lane-window; a cooldown parameter spaces entries
execution_model.maker: not in version 1: a maker candidate is rejected by the factory until the queue model is ported to numba; the canonical queue model stays openkal/sim_core.py Tape.queue_fill
execution_model.parity: on hold-to-settlement taker trades at a grid-aligned arrival the numba simulator must equal sim_core.run_trade on entry price, quantity, fee and PnL, exactly

generator.genome: up to 3 clauses of up to 3 conditions (feature, direction, threshold), the clauses OR-ed and the conditions AND-ed; a side rule (follow or fade a signed feature); entry window in seconds left; stake as a fraction of capital; cooldown; exit parameters
generator.search: a hand-rolled numpy genetic algorithm (tournament selection, uniform crossover, gaussian and swap mutation, elitism of the top 10%) and Optuna TPE for the thresholds of the top 10% on training data only
generator.learned_component: the LightGBM decision model enters only as one feature of the registry (milestone 2)

indicator_registry.status: PROVISIONAL: the Decision Agent indicator list was not available; this is the engine's own feature set. Replacing it bumps the version and is recorded on every candidate.

throughput_target: >= 10,000 candidates per hour on this machine, measured and reported, not assumed
reporting: every 2 hours: candidates scored, top 5 by out-of-sample EV with both bounds, anything promoted
known_before_registering: all research tracks to date (Tracks 1-11) found no taker or maker edge on the same tape; the market's ask is well calibrated (Brier about 0.2376 in band)
the tape holds 238 settled book-backed windows over 2.7 days; 46 have touch sizes
an independent backtest on 23.5k windows found no taker edge at 5 s or longer delay
expected: no candidate passes the corrected bound on 2.7 days of data; the factory's first job is to show that honestly and to be ready when more data arrives

screening_and_replay.tier_1_screen: the numba pass over the one-second feature matrix; target >= 10,000 candidates per minute across the machine's cores, measured and reported
screening_and_replay.tier_2_replay: the top 100 candidates per hour by screened train score are replayed event by event through openkal/sim_core.py (T+latency arrival, the queue model for resting orders, exact fees) on the same out-of-sample blocks; the leaderboard shows both numbers and only the replay may promote
screening_and_replay.agreement: a candidate whose replay net per trade differs from its screen by more than 25% of |screen| or changes sign is flagged and never promoted

judge_additions_v2.purged_cv: blocks split into train and test with every window within one window of a test block purged from train (embargo = 1 window), so no train feature overlaps a test trade
judge_additions_v2.pbo: probability of backtest overfitting by combinatorially symmetric cross-validation (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado, Zhu) on the block-by-candidate PnL matrix of each epoch, 16 blocks split in halves; reported per epoch and per family; a family whose PBO is above 0.5 cannot promote
judge_additions_v2.deflated_sharpe: the deflated Sharpe ratio (Bailey and Lopez de Prado) of each candidate's out-of-sample per-window PnL with the trial count N set to the number of distinct candidates tried in its epoch and family combined, using the sample skew and kurtosis; promotion needs DSR >= 0.95
judge_additions_v2.fresh_range_retest: a candidate that clears the judge is re-scored once on a date range that did not exist when it was selected (the windows recorded after its epoch's test blocks, or, when none exist yet, it waits); that re-test must also have EV > 0 with the lower bound > 0 at the owner's 95% level and >= 50 trades before it reaches the paper ladder
judge_additions_v2.count_every_candidate: every candidate that was scored in any tier, including mutants and Optuna trials and failures, is a row in the leaderboard and adds to N; a candidate deleted from the table is a protocol violation; the trial counter is stored beside the leaderboard and reported
judge_additions_v2.kept_from_v1: the owner's bars, the window-clustered Bonferroni bound, the leak guard and the 164 USD capital

layers.layer_1: LightGBM probability model of the side's win, walk-forward, used as one registry feature (milestone 2; needs the Decision Agent definition)
layers.layer_2: a small evolved decision net (inputs: registry features and the layer-1 probability; outputs: threshold, size fraction, sit-out) optimised directly on PnL after fees by an evolution strategy; the best runs' weights are averaged
layers.gpu: nvidia-smi reports no usable driver on this machine, so the net is evolved on the CPU in numba; it is tiny, so evosax and EvoTorch (JAX and PyTorch) add nothing yet and a hand-rolled evolution strategy is used; the optimiser is replaceable if a GPU becomes available

first_targets: combo quote pricing (waits for Session 1's recorder data)
fav_maker bid placement (the Track 11 family, with the queue model)
data_infrastructure: CF Benchmarks bitcoin index reconstruction from its constituent exchanges' public feeds
a strike-ladder snapshotter for the hourly and daily crypto ladders
other Kalshi series and spot feeds: read-only public collectors, my own background processes

amendments.reason: the owner's second brief added two-tier screening and replay, purged cross-validation, PBO, the deflated Sharpe ratio and a fresh-range re-test, an evolved decision net layer, first targets and the index reconstruction
amendments.made_before: any candidate was scored by any tier and any search ran on the feature matrix
amendments.not_changed: no v1 bar, bound, window rule or the leak guard
